ideas.pitch: A multi-agent autonomous swarm that simulates blind peer review for incoming UCL research preprints, verifying statistical validity and citation integrity.
ideas.title: AgentVerse Academic Peer Review Swarm
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the core AI-centric theme of AgentVerse with a practical academic use case suited for a university-hosted hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous agent system that negotiates and optimizes room booking, equipment sharing, and budget allocation across UCL student societies.
ideas.title: CampusCrowd Multi-Agent Resource Allocator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate, relatable operational bottleneck for university judges and student organizers.

ideas.pitch: An AI pipeline that automatically converts long-form UCL lecture audio recordings into structured knowledge graphs with automated quiz generation.
ideas.title: LectureLogic Knowledge Graph Extractor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies advanced multimodal extraction to student-specific data, providing instant utility that resonates with a university crowd.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision agent monitoring live or uploaded laboratory feeds to detect PPE compliance violations and hazardous chemical handling.
ideas.title: LabSafety Vision Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates hard engineering via computer vision integration rather than relying solely on a simple wrapper interface.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered technical mock interviewer agent that analyzes live voice responses, code syntax, and body language cues for UCL students.
ideas.title: AgentCareer Mock Interviewer Pro
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets high student demand for career prep, making the utility instantly understandable and engaging for live demos.
